recalls.title: Infant Sleep Positioners Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazard
recalls.description: Recalled due to risk of suffocation. The sleep positioners can cause babies to roll into an unsafe position.
recalls.hazard: Suffocation risk if infant rolls onto side or stomach
recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact the company for a full refund.

recalls.title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled Due to Strangulation Hazard
recalls.description: The drawstrings on children's upper outerwear can get caught on playground equipment and other objects, posing strangulation hazards.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should remove the drawstrings from the hooded sweatshirts immediately.
recalls.products: Boys' and Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings

recalls.title: Infant Bath Seats Recalled Due to Drowning Hazard
recalls.description: The suction cups can release unexpectedly, causing the bath seat to tip over, posing a drowning hazard to infants.
recalls.hazard: Drowning hazard if suction cups release
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bath seats and contact the firm for a full refund.

recalls.title: Wooden Teething Toys Recalled Due to Choking Hazard
recalls.description: The wooden beads can detach from the teething toys, posing a choking hazard to infants and toddlers.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled teething toys away from children and contact the company for a refund.

recalls.title: Infant Swings Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.description: The swing seat can detach from the base, posing a fall hazard to infants.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled swings and contact the company for a free repair kit.

recalls.title: Crib Mattresses Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazard
recalls.description: The mattresses are smaller than the cribs in which they are sold, creating a gap that poses a suffocation hazard.
recalls.hazard: Suffocation hazard due to gaps between mattress and crib
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled mattresses and contact the company for a full refund.

recalls.title: High Chairs Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
recalls.description: The restraint buckles can break, allowing the child to fall from the high chair.
recalls.hazard: Fall hazard if restraint buckle breaks
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the high chair and contact the company for a free replacement buckle.

recalls.title: Stroller Recalled Due to Fingertip Amputation Hazard
recalls.description: Children's fingertips can become caught in the stroller's hinges when unfolding, posing a fingertip amputation hazard.
recalls.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the stroller and contact the company for a free repair kit.
